question.prompt: In right triangle \(ABC\), \(\angle C=90^\circ\), and the median \(CD\) to the hypotenuse \(AB\) has length \(6.5\). Find the length of \(AB\).

solutions.explanation: The median to the hypotenuse is half the length of the hypotenuse, so \(AB=2CD=13\).
solutions.title: Double the hypotenuse median
